question: Will Saudi Arabia ask Egypt for help, yes or no?
hook_lines: EGYPT MPS VOTE TO DEFEND SAUDI

lines.text: Egypt's parliament has voted to let President Sisi send military support to Saudi Arabia.
It passed with a two thirds majority, the bar the constitution sets for combat missions abroad.
Sisi can take the necessary measures, but only if Riyadh asks for help.
Sisi says any action would protect Saudi borders, not attack Yemen.
On Monday the Houthis said they hit Saudi oil pumping stations and Riyadh airport again.
Saudi Arabia has not confirmed those claims.
The East West pipeline they named runs twelve hundred kilometres.
The Saudi led coalition says it destroyed five missile tunnels and four launchers.
Egypt has not made a large ground deployment abroad since the nineteen ninety one Gulf War.
Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani delegations also held talks in Tehran on Monday.
A Saudi official says the visit is aimed at de-escalation.
lines.note: Rayed Krimly on X, via The National

scene.quote: aimed at de-escalation and finding diplomatic solutions

lines.text: In Cairo, UN chief Antonio Guterres met Sisi and urged maximum restraint.
Cairo has said yes. Now it is Riyadh's call. Will Saudi Arabia ask Egypt for help, yes or no?
